thread:
emma-support: Hi @raj-billing — customer AcmeCorp (acct: acme-489) flagged invoice INV-9987: PDF shows 20% VAT (UK) but they provided an Ireland VAT (IE1234567). They need a corrected invoice for accounting.
raj-billing: Can you paste the invoice JSON from the billing API and the billing_address we used?
emma-support: Pasting minimal snippet from the API response:
```json
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-9987",
  "amount": 1000.00,
  "tax": 200.00,
  "tax_rate": 0.20,
  "tax_jurisdiction": "GB",
  "billing_address": { "country": "IE", "vat_number": "IE1234567" }
}
```
olivia-ops: Hmm. tax_jurisdiction=GB while billing_address.country=IE. Could be fallback to account-level country (legacy).
raj-billing: @jordan-eng any idea? Our tax calc should use VAT country when a valid VAT number exists.
jordan-eng: Reproduced locally. POST /v1/invoices with that body returns tax_rate 0.20 and jurisdiction GB. Repro steps: send same payload, inspect tax outcome. Looks like logic does: country = customer.billing_address.country || account.country; then lookup tax map. We don't currently derive country from VAT when billing_address.country is present but mismatched.
raj-billing: So whether VAT number present we should validate VAT and prefer its country for EU VAT rules. If VAT validation indicates IE, tax rate should be 0.23.
jordan-eng: Confirmed. Root cause: order of precedence in tax service. Fix: if vat_number present and vat validation passes, use vat_country as primary for VAT jurisdiction. I'll add unit tests.
maria-sales: Customer will need a corrected invoice and a credit note. They also require PO number attached to the corrected invoice — I'll coordinate the PO amendment.
tax-bot: tax-check: VAT IE1234567 validated via VIES — country=IE, status=active.
emma-support: Customer replied: "We were charged UK VAT. We have IE VAT and need the VAT amount corrected for our records. Please send corrected invoice + credit note. PO x-ACME-2024 will be provided once invoice matches." They want timeline.
raj-billing: Action plan: 1) eng to patch tax precedence and deploy to staging 2) billing to generate credit note & reissue invoice once patch is in prod 3) support to update customer with ETA 4) run audit for other EU accounts. Setting priority high.
jordan-eng: Patch pushed to staging (build 2024.07.12-taxfix). Added unit + integration tests. Scheduling prod deploy ~10:30 UTC pending checks.
raj-billing: Billing prepared credit note CN-9987 for the tax difference (original tax 200.00 vs correct 230.00 => difference 30.00). We issued CN-9987 and reissued INV-9987-R reflecting tax_rate=0.23 and updated VAT breakdown. Attachments uploaded to ticket BL-4521.
emma-support: Sent credit note + corrected invoice to customer and attached PO instructions. Customer confirmed they received documents and will accept once PO matches. They said timeline is fine.
incidents-bot: follow-up created ENG-789: tax mapping audit across EU regions to check for other accounts with missing/incorrect VAT country precedence.
emma-support: Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark: Thanks everyone.
